name: gymbot
description: AI workout coach: a React front end served by a Python backend (storage, Gemini, Google sign-in through IAP) on Cloud Run.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: npm run build:js -- --watch=forever & npm run build:css -- --watch=always & uv run python -m server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test tests/e2e/workout.test.mjs tests/e2e/activities.test.mjs tests/e2e/coach.test.mjs tests/e2e/data.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e
